blocks.heading: Graphic Design
blocks.kicker: Social, web, event, print and motion pieces, including work I designed for QAD Redzone, Cohesity, SOLV Energy and Healthier Texas.
blocks.tools: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Substance 3D

gallery.title: The History of the Assembly Line
gallery.desc:
This editorial-style series supported a feature on the Redzone blog and ran on social. It traces manufacturing from Henry Ford's moving assembly line to today's AI-enhanced Industry 4.0.
I blended collage and texture-rich visuals inspired by vintage magazines, so the story felt nostalgic and futuristic at once, bridging the past and future of factory innovation.
gallery.cap: I designed the collage series for a Redzone blog feature and its social posts.

gallery.src: QAD Redzone Presents_ Gary the GOAT
gallery.title: Parts Inventory Feature GIF with Gary
gallery.desc:
Inventory tracking isn't always the most exciting topic, so I added some energy with a looping animation featuring our official mascot, Gary the Goat. It ran across social and product channels to spotlight Redzone's inventory feature.
The animation leads with visual clarity and ends with a wink. I designed it to feel native to the brand and built entirely in-house, allowing us to repurpose it in everything from web explainers to internal campaigns.
gallery.cap: I designed the looping animation with Gary the Goat, Redzone's mascot, for social and product channels.

gallery.title: Redzone Pocket Coach: April Fools' Campaign (2025)
gallery.desc:
For Redzone's April Fools' campaign, Pocket Coach opens on an iPad spinning through space before the screen gives way to a grassy field, where a pixel-art Gary the Goat in a red jersey runs up to greet the viewer.
I staged the reveal like a polished product launch, then let the 8-bit mascot steal the show before closing on a clean QAD | Redzone lockup, keeping the joke firmly on brand.
gallery.cap: QAD Redzone April Fools' campaign, 2025. I built the spinning iPad and animated Gary, staged like a product launch.

gallery.title: Productivity and Engagement with Manufacturing All Stars
gallery.desc:
Web banners highlighting productivity and engagement stats, set against a real manufacturing team at work. I layered each stat over candid photos of our customers.
The layout was optimized for paid media and retargeting campaigns, with bold type and a single focused stat so the message cuts through quickly in scroll-heavy feeds.
gallery.cap: Web banners I designed for the paid media and retargeting campaigns I ran, with the stat set over candid photos of a real customer team.

gallery.title: Customer Testimonials: Web & Social Graphics
gallery.desc:
A set of branded testimonials for Redzone's web and social channels, each built around a tangible result, like a 34% changeover time reduction or the equivalent of a free plant's worth of capacity.
Quotes from frontline leaders at Nestlé Purina, Post Consumer Brands, and Gorilla Glue sit alongside brand-aligned photography and data visuals. I let the customer voices lead, using layout and color to keep the focus on their results.
gallery.cap: I designed Redzone's testimonial set for web and social and let the customer quotes lead.

gallery.title: Slide-to-Unlock iPad Mailer for Prospective Customers
gallery.desc:
To break through the noise of traditional sales mailers, I designed an iPad box that played on the nostalgic 'slide to unlock' gesture. A cutout window with a movable paper insert revealed phrases like 'Empowering the Frontline' and 'Unlock Your Factory's Potential.'
The mailer went to select prospects based on their stage in the sales funnel.
gallery.cap: A mailer I designed to look like an iPad box, with a window and a sliding insert that reveals lines like Empowering the Frontline. It went to selected prospects by their stage in the sales funnel.

gallery.title: Cohesity Event, Blog, Webinar, and Hiring Graphics
gallery.desc:
A cross-section of Cohesity's busiest channels in one spread: a Google Cloud Next 26 booth promo for Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas, a blog hero announcing that the future of support is agentic, a ransomware webinar card, a We're Hiring post for São Paulo, and an NVIDIA GTC 2026 event graphic.
I held every piece to Cohesity's bright green and magenta palette with tight condensed type, so very different messages still read as one credible set.
gallery.cap: I held the set to Cohesity's green and magenta palette across event, blog, webinar and hiring posts.

gallery.title: SOLV Energy Announcement and Case Study Teaser Graphics
gallery.desc:
The left graphic is an "In Case You Missed It" announcement about SOLV Energy's O&M scale and largest single-site agreement, set over a field photo of solar panels and wildflowers.
The right is a case study teaser that opens with a question about underperforming sites. I let the white space and the sunburst frame do the work, ending with a simple prompt to read the case study.
gallery.cap: I designed SOLV Energy's In Case You Missed It announcement and the case study teaser.

gallery.title: SOLV Energy Conference Speaker Card and Kudos Post
gallery.desc:
These two cover both sides of SOLV Energy's event presence. On the left, a speaking session card for CFO Chad Plotkin at the 38th Annual ROTH Conference. On the right, a kudos post recognizing Kate for representing the company at the 2026 IECA Annual Conference & Expo.
Both are built on the brand's signature blues and sunburst motif, with a headline hierarchy that stays readable even as a small social thumbnail.
gallery.cap: I designed SOLV Energy's conference speaker card and the kudos post.

gallery.title: RE+ 2025 Event and Speaking Session Graphics
gallery.desc:
For RE+ in Las Vegas, I made a pair of graphics: a bold blue announcement for the event and a darker companion piece listing SOLV Energy's two speaking sessions with Eric Butticaz, Director of Apprenticeship, including times and rooms.
The Venetian skyline and SOLV's sunburst mark tie the two together, while the lime accents and clear type keep the session details easy to read at thumbnail size on social.
gallery.cap: I made SOLV Energy's RE+ event announcement and the speaking session card.

gallery.title: Texas Sweats for Pets: Campaign Social Graphics
gallery.desc:
Texas Sweats for Pets was a virtual fitness-a-thon from Healthier Texas that invited Texans to work out alongside their pets at the start of 2021. I led the visual direction and created all the key graphic assets.
Vibrant illustrations and high-energy type brought warmth to a fully digital experience, from 'Fur & Fitness' posts to a three-ways-to-join card, all built around the partnership with Austin Pets Alive!
gallery.cap: I led the visual direction and created the key graphics for this Healthier Texas campaign.

gallery.title: Healthier Texas Summit Speaker Highlights
gallery.desc:
A speaker spotlight series promoting the annual Healthier Texas Summit, featuring keynote guests like Vice Admiral Jerome M. Adams and Dr. Nadine Gracia in a bold, clean layout.
Subtle gradients and textured overlays added visual warmth while reinforcing credibility, in line with the summit's mission of public health equity.
gallery.cap: I designed the speaker spotlight series for the Healthier Texas Summit.

gallery.title: Healthy Texas Week Logo Design
gallery.desc:
Made for a statewide wellness initiative, this logo pairs playful retro script lettering with a bold blue Texas silhouette. I wanted it to feel inviting and optimistic, something families and educators could rally around.
The script adds movement and personality across digital and print. Though the event was ultimately cancelled due to COVID-19, the mark still served as a unifying visual during the early campaign rollout.
gallery.cap: I designed the Healthy Texas Week logo in Illustrator.

blocks.heading: Freelance and Self-Initiated
blocks.kicker: Pieces made outside the day job: a freelance promo for LANY, and briefs I set myself.
blocks.tools: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign, Figma

gallery.title: Fall in Style: Editorial Promo
gallery.desc:
Self-initiated. A promotional concept for a fall fashion campaign, built on a brief I set for myself: capture the feeling of mid-air motion and let the visual lead the storytelling.
Large, condensed type and a minimalist palette anchor the dynamic composition, while the floating figure, subtly shadowed for depth, carries the seasonal call to action. The result could live in a print magazine or serve as key art for a digital ad set.

gallery.title: Hushhum AI: Marketing Materials
gallery.desc:
Self-initiated. Hushhum is an AI-powered ambience app that helps people focus, sleep, and relax with customizable white, pink, and green noise. As a concept launch campaign, I created lifestyle-driven social graphics that lead with the emotional benefit rather than the feature set.
Sun-warmed portraits and fluid shapes mirror the calming waveforms of ambient sound, each paired with a short, lyrical line of copy.

gallery.title: LANY Live at Stubb's: Instagram Story Promo
gallery.desc:
Freelance. A promotional piece for indie-pop band LANY's live show at Stubb's BBQ in Austin, TX, designed for the vertical, fast-scrolling world of Instagram Stories.
Layered typography bleeds downward with subtle opacity and color shifts, mimicking the rhythm and buildup before a concert, while the high-contrast hero photo puts viewers eye-level with the band.

gallery.title: Daily News Social Template System
gallery.desc:
Self-initiated. This series of square social graphics was built as a template system for daily news updates across categories like the stock market, the auto industry, real estate and manufacturing. Each category gets its own accent color, carried through a small "News" tag and corner brackets.
I paired full-bleed, high-impact photography with bold condensed headlines so each update reads in a split second, with a consistent footer tying the set together.

gallery.title: Go the Mile: Outdoor Promotional Poster
gallery.desc:
Self-initiated. Inspired by outdoor lifestyle brands and editorial photography, this poster pairs dramatic imagery with oversized type. 'Go the Mile' works as both a motivational message and a literal call to explore.
The muted palette and textures reinforce the natural setting, and minimal copy lets the image carry the emotional weight. I wanted a cover that reads from a distance and holds up close.

gallery.title: Fashion E-Commerce Interface
gallery.desc:
Self-initiated. This fashion interface was designed to feel bold and energetic, with a heavy emphasis on visual identity and shopability. A high-contrast palette and oversized grid put products first across web and mobile.
I included interactive components like real-time color swatches and review stars to simulate a full user experience. The mobile version keeps the same hierarchy, with a card-style, digital-wallet aesthetic.

blocks.heading: Presentations
blocks.kicker: Presentation design for QAD Redzone, plus team decks from my marketing courses at Texas A&M University's Mays Business School.

gallery.title: Apple Campus Event Presentation for NAMA 2023
gallery.desc:
The cover for an excerpt from a presentation I designed for an Apple campus event for NAMA 2023, which a colleague presented. Frontline workers holding rugged tablets stand in a near-black frame beside a timeline that climbs from 700 in 2020 to 1,200 in 2023.
I kept the type light and let a single red accent mark the current year, so the people and the numbers carry the story. The full excerpt opens as a PDF.

gallery.title: Apple Presentation: Community Growth Slide
gallery.desc:
This keynote visual kicked off a manufacturing leadership summit hosted by Apple. I paired growth stats with real frontline workers to keep the human impact behind the numbers front and center.
Working alongside Apple's team, I refined it with a more stylized illustration concept and shadowing that tied brand color to Apple's cinematic depth. The presentation was delivered by QAD Redzone's Blake Strickland.

gallery.title: MKTG 327 Study: Digital Campaign for Chili's
gallery.desc:
This study explored how to reinvigorate a plateaued restaurant brand through online and in-store changes, with research and feedback from Chili's Bar & Grill.
We found that casual dining had been declining and that each social platform called for a different tone. The plan targeted young families with children through social advertising.

gallery.title: Social Media Campaign: How Universities Communicate
gallery.desc:
Prepared for Mays Business School, this study looked at how universities use social media to share information, including a close look at a peer school's Facebook strategy.
Our research found that people prefer interpersonal posts, with Facebook skewing older and Instagram younger. We recommended Instagram Stories content, such as a "day in the life of a business major" series.

gallery.title: MKTG 322 Presentation: Reviving the Pinterest Brand
gallery.desc:
This presentation looked at how Pinterest could win back users by understanding what today's customers want.
The research highlighted food waste among 18 to 34 year olds and the weight people give to friends' recommendations. Our idea was an add-on feature that scans grocery barcodes, tracks expiration dates and suggests recipes before food goes bad.

contact.statement: Hiring for a content, web, or marketing operations role? I would like to talk.

gallery.title: Nike App Shop Tab and Sport Category Screens
gallery.desc:
Two Nike app screens side by side: the Shop tab, opening on a Nike 24.7 Collection carousel above Shoes, Clothing, Accessories and Sport tiles, and the Sport page it leads into, with a tennis hero up top.
Below that hero sits a row of collection cards, from Basketball Must-Haves to the ACG Chamo Camo Collection. Each tile in the grid had to open onto the right category before anything went live.

gallery.title: The Empire Strikes Backups Champions Newsletter
gallery.desc:
A Star Wars nod for a data security company was too good to pass up. The Empire Strikes Backups newsletter opens with a glowing green title over a starfield, followed by a Top Content to Share ticker and story cards with one-click Share buttons.
I designed it to make sharing feel like a game for Champions, pulling the week's best posts into a single scroll so advocates could share in seconds without hunting for links.

gallery.title: Hard in the Paint Tennis Landing Page
gallery.desc:
A tennis landing page built around the Slam City Collection, led by a "Hard in the Paint" hero that asks shoppers to gear up for NYC's biggest tennis showdown. Below it, an Athlete Picks carousel routes into Carlos Alcaraz, Naomi Osaka and Serena Williams.
The second view carries the surface into Look of Tennis and Slam Collection entry points plus a Popular Right Now grid. Each tile had to resolve to the right shop before anything went live.

gallery.title: Texans Thrive on the Web
gallery.desc:
At the start of the pandemic, Healthier Texas launched Texans Thrive, a statewide storytelling campaign built to connect communities through shared experience. I designed the visual identity for the site and all of its campaign graphics.
The layout is clean and mobile-forward, anchored by warm photography and user-submitted stories, so each one reads like a page from a community scrapbook. Custom illustrations and call-to-action modules invite visitors to share their own voices.

gallery.title: SOLV Energy Homepage Hero Walkthrough
gallery.desc:
This is the front door of solvenergy.com: a wide aerial of a solar field, the SOLV mark, and a hero line that sums up the company in four words, Powering Progress with Proven Execution. I kept the site current as project, leadership, and earnings news landed.
Updates often went live within hours of internal approval, with formatting, imagery, and SEO handled before publish so the homepage always reflected where the company actually was.

gallery.title: Texas Sweats for Pets: Donations Welcome
gallery.desc:
Texas Sweats for Pets was a three-day virtual fitness-a-thon, January 27 to 29, 2021, with live classes from It's Time Texas instructors and adoptable cats and dogs from Austin Pets Alive!. This email opens on the illustrated campaign header and the line "One Event. Two Great Causes."
Below it, a Make a Donation button and a Three Easy Ways to Get Involved section give readers a clear next step, from giving to signing up as a fundraiser.

gallery.title: Redzone Videos & Content
gallery.desc:
Real screenshots of the Redzone website at the time, showing two sides of it: a filterable resource library on desktop and a video page on mobile. Each card leads with a branded cover, from infographics like 'Analytics for Everyone' to the 'Tales of Triumph from the Factory Floor' ebook.
The goal was the same as the rest of my feature work: keep complex topics clean and inviting. On the video page, real team members fill the frame before the copy explains anything, so visitors meet the people first and the platform second.

gallery.title: Back in Style Back to School App Story
gallery.desc:
A Back to School placement in the Nike app, opening on two students in Nike gear on stadium bleachers under the headline "Head back to school in style." The copy invites shoppers to find looks for school, sport and everything in between.
I previewed it on device before scheduling, since this kind of story is usually met on a phone with the sound off. It had to read in a glance and route cleanly into the gear.

gallery.title: Back to School and Nike x LEGO App Screens
gallery.desc:
A pair of Nike app screens. On the left, a Back to School card offering top picks for staying ahead of the game sits above a backpack shelf, with the Nike Varsity Elite beside a silver Best Seller.
On the right, the Nike X LEGO Collection page filters by Shoes and Tops and opens on a Nike Soccer x LEGO hero of minifigures in team kits. Both had to route cleanly from story to product.

gallery.title: Monthly Mix: July Newsletter
gallery.desc:
The July 2020 edition of It's Time Texas Monthly Mix opens on a quote from March of Dimes President and CEO Stacey Stewart about racism in healthcare. The lead story, from the It's Time Texas Blog, examines health disparities in the context of COVID-19.
The layout leans on one illustrated row of workers across many professions, followed by a short recap of that month's Community Lab forum and a Read the Blog button that carries readers to the full post.

gallery.title: Play Mind Games Nike Mind Landing Page
gallery.desc:
A landing page for Nike Mind and the 24.7 Collection, led by a "Play Mind Games" hero that invites shoppers to lock in before the game. An Explore Nike Mind row below breaks the footwear down in close-up product imagery.
I assembled the hero, copy and product row into one surface and routed the Shop button into the collection. The recording shows how the page moves from the campaign image into the product story.

gallery.title: #BlackLivesMatter: Read Our Statement
gallery.desc:
Under a Black Lives Matter kicker, this It's Time Texas newsletter leads with Race and Justice in Public Health, set over a mural of open, multicolored hands. The copy names two public health crises, COVID-19 and systemic racism, and quotes the organization's statement of solidarity.
A Read the Statement button points to the full text, while a Coming Soon block below announces that the Healthier Texas Summit is moving online.

gallery.title: Tennis Slam Product Grid on Nike.com
gallery.desc:
A Tennis Slam product grid on Nike.com showing 96 results, with category filters on the left and NikeCourt Slam apparel and Nike GP Challenge 1.5 PRM shoes in the grid.
Product grids are where a campaign turns into something people can buy. I set up the grid and its filters so the collection loaded with the right products and every tile resolved to a working product page.

gallery.title: ACG Zegama Hike App Feature
gallery.desc:
An app feature for the ACG Zegama Hike, opening on a cinematic shot of a globe and circuitry stamped "All Conditions Research Dept." The headline below calls it a rock-solid shoe with trail runner DNA.
I built the placement from the supplied video and copy, then checked it on a real device so the motion, type and navigation held up together. A desktop preview would have hidden how the story actually plays on a phone.

gallery.title: Jannik Sinner Graphic Tee Product Page
gallery.desc:
A product page on Nike.com for the Jannik Sinner Men's NikeCourt Dri-FIT Graphic Tennis T-Shirt, with an image gallery, size selector, Add to Bag and pickup options.
This is where every placement and grid eventually has to land. A tile that routes anywhere else is a product someone cannot buy, so I traced destinations through to pages like this one before anything was scheduled.

gallery.title: Mark Bowman Back-to-School Styles App Story
gallery.desc:
Back-to-School Styles in the Nike app, starring USC Football's Mark Bowman on a campus bench with a ball in hand. The carousel card on the left opens into the full story on the right, where the copy calls him a tight end who brings focused energy to all he does.
Talent-led placements like this need the name, school and position exactly right, and the Apparel link has to land in the right shop.

gallery.title: Gear for a Great Year Back to School Carousel
gallery.desc:
A Back to School page on Nike.com with First-Day Footwear, Backpacks, Shop All and Sport Ready navigation above a "Gear for a Great Year" carousel. Athlete photography labeled Jazzy Davidson of USC Basketball and Lamar Bo Jackson of Ohio State Football routes into Women's, Kids and Men's shops.
Talent-led tiles carry extra weight, so every name and destination had to be exactly right for the season's publishing window.

gallery.title: Shop Women's, Men's and All Entry Tiles
gallery.desc:
A row of three category entry tiles routing into Shop Women's, Shop Men's and Shop All, each built on bold athletic photography in a track, a locker room and a sports-room setting. The footwear in each image sits front and center.
I placed the imagery and wired each tile to its destination, keeping the labels short so the row reads in a glance on desktop and mobile.

gallery.title: Community Challenge 101
gallery.desc:
An animated email for the It's Time Texas Community Challenge, headed Everything You Need to Know and built from rotating tiles for sharing the journey, shopping gear and what to expect this year. Connect. Commit. Contribute. sets the tone below.
The copy invites readers to start a fundraising team or donate to keep the 8-week Challenge free, then closes on a single Learn More button.

gallery.title: Men's Hero Carousel on Nike.com
gallery.desc:
A men's landing page on Nike.com with a rotating hero carousel under the Shop All, Shoes, Clothing, Accessories and Sale navigation. This recording shows the motion between slides, from a trail shoe in mid-stride to a close portrait.
Featured placements like this are often the first thing someone sees on the site. I built and checked them so each slide loaded fast and landed on the right destination.

gallery.title: Mia Corona Back-to-School Styles App Story
gallery.desc:
Another Back-to-School Styles story in the Nike app, this one featuring incoming UCLA freshman and midfielder Mia Corona in a striped Nike jersey against warm wood paneling. The carousel card links to Apparel, and the full story pairs her portrait with a short line of copy.
Stories like this are met on a phone in a quick swipe between cards, so the photo, name and copy all had to read at a glance.

blocks.heading: Web, App, & Email
blocks.kicker: Web content, app content, intranet, HTML and CSS, block editing, copywriting
blocks.tools: Adobe Experience Manager, WordPress, Craft CMS, HubSpot, MailChimp, Constant Contact, Microsoft Power Apps, SharePoint, Shopify
body: Web pages, app screens and notifications, intranet hubs, newsletters, event reminders, and product listings, published inside fixed release windows with the accessibility checks and QA routing that come with them, and co-branded campaign content made with the University of Texas, SNAP, and Blue Cross Blue Shield.

gallery.title: Good Energy
gallery.desc:
This vertical social piece opens on a sweeping aerial of a SOLV Energy project under construction, with crews, trucks, and structures spread across the site. It's one of the short-form videos I helped concept, script, and produce for project milestones and culture moments.
I kept the editing minimal so the work on the ground carried the story, with light branding and pacing tuned for social feeds.

gallery.title: A Message from SOLV Energy CEO, George Hershman
gallery.desc:
Sometimes the best move is to let leadership talk. Here, SOLV Energy CEO George Hershman speaks directly to camera in a relaxed interview setting about the company and its work.
I kept the edit simple and the speaker central, the same approach I took across SOLV's video content: let the people behind the company speak for themselves, with branding that supports the message instead of competing with it.

gallery.title: Overview and Impact of Misae Solar
gallery.desc:
A drone shot over rows of panels stretching toward the horizon opens this vertical site overview of the Misae Solar project. It was one of several pieces I helped produce to show audiences what SOLV Energy's projects look like up close.
I paired on-site footage with light brand overlays and kept the pacing quick enough for LinkedIn while still giving the scale of the site room to land.

gallery.title: A Closer Look into QAD Redzone's 4 Modules
gallery.desc:
A four-minute overview of Redzone's four connected modules (Productivity, Compliance, Reliability, and Learning) and how they work together on the factory floor. I concepted, scripted, directed, and edited it as the starting point for anyone new to Redzone or weighing the full platform.
Rather than a screen-recorded feature list, team members walk through the platform on camera, so the software reads as something real people use to communicate faster and fix problems sooner.

gallery.title: Mars Men PSA
gallery.desc:
This short vertical PSA opens on a man in a puffer jacket and sunglasses talking straight into a handheld mic against snow and evergreens, with bold on-screen captions setting an irreverent tone for a men's health message.
I kept it under a minute and captioned for sound-off viewing, letting the direct-to-camera delivery and the cheeky text do the work of stopping the scroll.

gallery.title: We Power What's Next at SOLV Energy
gallery.desc:
This one opens somewhere unexpected for an energy company: a deep blue night sky full of stars. From there it builds toward SOLV Energy's line, We Power What's Next, as a culture piece for both social and internal audiences.
I helped concept and produce it with the rule I used across SOLV's video work: minimal editing, the people kept central, and pacing that fits LinkedIn and longer-form internal use alike.

gallery.title: Tackling Food Insecurity with Urban Roots
gallery.desc:
This partner spotlight heads out to the farm with Urban Roots, a nonprofit working to fight food insecurity. I wanted the story to come straight from the people doing the work, so it's built around an on-site interview set against rows of fresh greens.
I handled production end to end, from scripting and filming to editing and motion, for a short, grounded film that puts a human face on the partnerships behind Healthier Texas' programs.

gallery.title: 2020 Community Challenge with Austin Mayor Steve Adler
gallery.desc:
For the 2020 Community Challenge, I filmed Austin Mayor Steve Adler in his office, surrounded by the city's past Community Challenge trophies. Basketball in hand, he invites Austinites to get moving and help defend the title.
I wanted a public leader's message to feel approachable and playful, so the framing leans on the trophies and props instead of a formal podium address, and keeping it under a minute made it easy to share.

gallery.title: 2021 Community Challenge App Instructional Video
gallery.desc:
When the Community Challenge moved into a new app, participants needed a clear, friendly guide to getting started. I produced this walkthrough to introduce the app and show people how to join in.
It opens on the bright orange Community Challenge branding and carries that energy throughout, with pacing and clarity tuned so first-time users of any comfort level could follow along and feel ready to participate.

gallery.title: Deep Dive into QAD Redzone Modules
gallery.desc:
The longer walkthrough, built around the 29% productivity increase behind the platform. It shows each module in action, from live OEE, throughput, and downtime data in Productivity to a fully paperless shop floor in Compliance, with production, quality, and maintenance teams working from the same live data.
Where the four-module overview earns attention, this one answers the detailed questions prospects and new users bring next.

blocks.heading: Video Work
blocks.tools: Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, CapCut, Claude, ChatGPT, Riverside.fm
body: Customer stories filmed on plant floors, culture pieces, product walkthroughs, and event content for SOLV Energy, QAD Redzone, and Healthier Texas, with guests including former City of Austin Mayor Steve Adler and nonprofit partners like Urban Roots.

gallery.title: Healthier Texas Summit: Call for Proposals
gallery.desc:
This Facebook post opened the call for proposals for the 2022 Healthier Texas Summit, a collaboration between It's Time Texas and The University of Texas System. I paired a candid photo of an attendee speaking up during a session with the summit lockup and a clear "Apply Now" band.
The goal was to show the summit as a place where every voice gets the mic, inviting professionals to bring sessions, discussions and workshops of their own.

gallery.title: Productivity & Turnover
gallery.desc:
Tax Day gave this LinkedIn post a timely hook: while everyone was thinking about savings, it made the case for savings on the manufacturing floor. The copy plays on receipts and refunds, then points to Redzone's G2 rating as proof from the community.
For the graphic, I set the productivity and turnover stats over a candid photo of a frontline team gathered around a tablet, closing with a bold "Book a Demo" button.

gallery.title: We Power What's Next at RE+
gallery.desc:
Event coverage from RE+ 2025 in Las Vegas, posted to SOLV Energy's Facebook page. The collage leads with a wall-sized "We Power What's Next" screen towering over attendees, followed by shots of the show floor, a wrapped SOLV display and a gauge graphic carrying the same line.
The caption opens with the idea that almost every connection at RE+ starts with two words, and the photos were chosen to prove that point at a glance.

gallery.title: Parts Inventory Webinar Post with Gary
gallery.desc:
"You goat to go" set the tone for this LinkedIn post promoting a Redzone webinar on the new Parts Inventory feature in the Reliability module. To make a CMMS walkthrough feel inviting, I animated our mascot, Gary the Goat, popping in beside a tablet as the app moves from the dashboard to the parts list.
The loop ends on a simple callout, "Need a part?", so the feature's value lands even before anyone reads the caption.

gallery.title: We'll See You in Las Vegas
gallery.desc:
Ahead of RE+ 2025 in Las Vegas, I designed this announcement for SOLV Energy's Instagram. Cut-out photos of the Venetian and Palazzo towers sit alongside SOLV crew members in hard hats, all on a bold blue field with the RE+ mark and SOLV's sunburst.
The scrapbook-style collage gave a trade-show save-the-date some personality, and the "Straight Outta Desert Center" hard hat sticker added a wink for people who know the work.

gallery.title: History of the Assembly Line Carousel for Blog
gallery.desc:
This LinkedIn carousel supported a Redzone blog feature on the history of the assembly line, moving from Ransom Olds and Henry Ford through the age of automation to Industry 4.0. I built each frame with collage and texture inspired by vintage magazines, plus a red-and-cyan offset that nods to old 3D prints.
The final slide brings in Gary the Goat in 3D glasses with a "Book A Demo" call to action, ending the history lesson on a playful note.

gallery.title: Texas Sweats for Pets: 3 Ways to Join
gallery.desc:
Texas Sweats for Pets was a virtual fitness-a-thon from Healthier Texas, It's Time Texas and Austin Pets Alive! that invited Texans to work out alongside their pets. For launch day, I designed this Instagram graphic laying out three ways to join: buy a ticket, donate $5 for a drawing entry, or start a fundraiser.
A flat illustration of a walker and pup, paw-print bullets and a "Starts Today at 6pm!" badge kept the message warm and easy to act on.

gallery.title: Game Day at the Redzone Booth
gallery.desc:
Football season gave this LinkedIn video its playbook. The post opens on sports-style copy about fierce players and unmatched teamwork, then cuts to a Redzone team member at our football-themed trade show booth, ball in hand, walking viewers through the platform.
The clip ends on a close-up of the productivity dashboard on a tablet, so the sports metaphor lands on the real product frontline teams use every day.

gallery.title: Father's Day Letter from Redzone
gallery.desc:
For Father's Day, this Redzone LinkedIn post told the story of Francisco, a frontline team member following in the footsteps of his father, who retired after a long career on the Jelly Belly Candy Company factory floor. The story is set as a letter tucked into a red envelope sealed with the Redzone mark.
The post simply reads "With Love, Redzone," letting the letter carry the emotion: legacy as pride in work done well.

gallery.title: Creating Healthy Habits Instagram Live
gallery.desc:
This Instagram Live on the Healthier Texas account was a relaxed conversation about creating healthy habits, filmed at a kitchen table with a mug of coffee in hand. Going live gave followers a real-time, conversational way into the topic instead of a polished ad.
The casual setting suited the subject, since building healthy habits is really about small, everyday choices, and a familiar face made that message feel approachable.

gallery.title: 2023 QAD Redzone Open Charity Golf Tournament
gallery.desc:
Event day for the 2nd Annual QAD Redzone Open Charity Golf Tournament, which the post shares had raised over $70,000 for the Special Operations Warrior Foundation. The collage pairs a tee shot framed by onlookers, an artist live-painting the course, and players warming up on the driving range.
Community events were part of the Redzone story too, and this coverage showed the relationships behind the software away from the plant floor.

gallery.title: February Work Anniversaries with QAD Redzone
gallery.desc:
Each month I designed a branded post celebrating Redzone team members' work anniversaries, and February leaned into Valentine's season with hearts, paper airplanes, a hot air balloon and a pink skyline. Headshots sit in alternating red, navy and white frames so a grid of 19 faces still feels lively.
These posts were small morale boosters that reminded people they were valued, and they often sparked congratulations and resharing across the team.

gallery.title: Leading the Way: Women on the Frontline
gallery.desc:
For Women's History Month, I designed this LinkedIn document carousel spotlighting women driving change at Redzone customer sites. Each page pairs a portrait with real accomplishments, like Mireya Jimenez leading digital adoption at Pioneer Frozen Foods, Shannon Bone building a safety and waste committee from scratch, and Mallory Chavez helping her team adopt new tech.
The purple, award-style layouts put recognition and visibility at the center.

gallery.title: Summit Podcast Narration
gallery.desc:
This LinkedIn video shares a snippet from the Food Safety Matters podcast, recorded live at the Food Safety Summit with Andrew Lansinger of QAD Redzone. His message about giving frontline team members a voice, a platform and recognition runs as narration over footage from the show floor.
Burned-in captions make the clip work with the sound off, and cuts between the podcast set and the Redzone booth keep the pace moving.

gallery.title: Manufacturing Carousel for Blog
gallery.desc:
I designed this LinkedIn carousel to break down Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), one of Redzone's more technical subjects. Frames move from what OEE is (availability x performance x quality) to why it matters, common inefficiencies and the power of real-time data.
Isometric illustrations of the production line and bold condensed headlines keep the stats-heavy content clean and on brand, turning a dense topic into something easy to swipe through.

gallery.title: 2023 Holidays with QAD Redzone
gallery.desc:
To close out the year, this LinkedIn post thanked the Redzone community for the stories that inspire our work. The animated card is a tablet-shaped frame wishing everyone a joyful holiday season and a successful 2023, with snowflakes drifting across a Redzone-red background.
The loop is short and quiet on purpose: a warm sign-off that fits the feed without competing with the message of thanks.

gallery.title: Supporting Our Frontline Workers
gallery.desc:
For #GivingTuesdayNow, this It's Time Texas Instagram carousel thanked nurses, community health workers and essential workers. The caption invited followers to tag someone supporting health and share a story of appreciation.
The design pairs a portrait of a masked healthcare worker with bold, stacked type on bright blue bars, kept simple so the gratitude is the first thing people read.

gallery.title: 2021 Community Challenge Recap with Mayor Ron Nirenberg
gallery.desc:
To build momentum for the 2022 It's Time Texas Community Challenge, this #FlashbackFriday post on Healthier Texas's Facebook revisited San Antonio Mayor Ron Nirenberg accepting the Metro-sized community award for his area at the previous competition.
A public leader speaking straight to camera from his office made the challenge feel personal, while the branded #CommunityChallenge lower third and registration link turned the throwback into a call to sign up.

gallery.title: Two Different Shows Across the World
gallery.desc:
Greetings from FABTECH and PACK EXPO: QAD Redzone took over two cities at once, and this LinkedIn video brought both shows into one post. The booth team tosses a football in front of our football-themed booth before Gary the Goat pops in holding a "Get Certified" sign.
The goal was to show the energy at both booths and invite manufacturers in Chicago and Las Vegas to stop by or book a demo.

gallery.title: Compliance Workshop Invite
gallery.desc:
This LinkedIn post invited QAD Redzone community admins to a Compliance Workshop hosted by Joe Thielen, Customer Success Coach, opening on the line that compliance isn't just about meeting standards, it's about setting them.
The short video cuts from frontline conversations on the plant floor to close-ups of the app on a tablet, then resolves into the Redzone logo, keeping the focus on the people who use the tools every day.

gallery.title: 2024 New Year's with QAD Redzone
gallery.desc:
"Let's make 2024 the Year of the Connected Worker!" This LinkedIn post rang in the new year by spotlighting real Redzone customers instead of a generic greeting, linking to a roundup of success stories from around our community.
I animated a disco-ball "Happy New Year" over a lineup of frontline team members, then let red and blue fireworks burst before resolving on the QAD Redzone logo.

body: Organic content for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube: frontline workers on camera, seasonal campaigns with a voice of their own, employee advocacy creative people chose to put on their own networks, event coverage and original photography, and partner content with NVIDIA, Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Anthropic.

gallery.title: Redzone Case Study: Coil Specialist, Inc.
gallery.desc:
This Redzone case study follows Coil Specialist, Inc., a component manufacturer that drove productivity up 37% with QAD Redzone. Writing customer stories meant interviewing people about the results they saw on the plant floor, then shaping those conversations into a clear narrative.
I structured the piece to be found in search and repurposed across web, email and social. The full case study is available here as a PDF.

gallery.title: Cohesity and Google Cloud Unite to Tackle Hidden Threats
gallery.desc:
Co-written with Google Cloud, this Cohesity blog looks at how the two companies work together to tackle hidden security threats. Partner pieces like this meant balancing two brands' voices and technical points of view while keeping the story clear for the reader.
I structured the post to be found in search and repurposed across web, email and social. The full blog is available here as a PDF.

gallery.title: Ghostwriting for Executive Leaders
gallery.desc: Not every byline is my own. These cards collect ghostwriting for executive leaders at national and global organizations, including Cohesity, Redzone and SOLV Energy, turning c-suite perspectives into thought leadership that sounds like the person signing it.

gallery.title: How Does Social Support Affect Your Health
gallery.desc:
Written for Healthier Texas, this article explores the link between social connection and everyday health. Health explainers like this one start with research and turn it into plain language for everyday readers, without losing the substance.
I structured the piece to be found in search and easy to repurpose across web, email and social. The full article is available here as a PDF.

gallery.title: Redzone Case Study: Companion Baking Company
gallery.desc:
Companion Baking Company's story centers on enlisting everyone on the team to improve equipment reliability with Redzone. For case studies like this, I interviewed customers about the results they saw on the plant floor and built the narrative around their experience.
The headline puts people first, and the piece was structured to be found in search and repurposed across web, email and social. The full case study is available here as a PDF.

blocks.heading: Long-Form: Blogs, Case Studies, and Executive Thought Leadership
blocks.kicker: Customer stories, c-suite perspectives, partner works, health explainers

body: Customer case studies, partner blogs, and health explainers: interviewing customers about the results they saw on the plant floor, co-writing with Google Cloud on security, and turning health research into plain language for everyday readers. Each piece is structured to be found in search and repurposed across web, email, and social.

gallery.title: White Paper: Linkedin InMail Ad
gallery.desc:
This sponsored InMail invited new community partners into It's Time Texas' free, confidential health coaching program. Sent from a program director's profile, it reads like a personal note, walking through weekly phone consultations, text and email follow-up, and services in English and Spanish.
I kept the subject line direct and put a single Learn More button up top, so the ask was clear before anyone scrolled into the details.

gallery.title: Leaderboard Ad for Pack Expo
gallery.desc:
A leaderboard banner for QAD Redzone at Pack Expo Las Vegas, shown here running across the top of Food Business News. It fits the brand lockup, a Book a Demo button, and the booth number, SU-8233, into one strip.
The right side belongs to frontline workers in hairnets gathered around a tablet, so food manufacturers see people like their own teams before they ever reach the booth.

gallery.title: Cohesity Catalyst Paris
gallery.desc:
A 14-second promo for Cohesity Catalyst on Tour in Paris, built around a save-the-date poster set on a tree-lined Paris street, with the Eiffel Tower, March 12 date, and 1:00 to 5:30 PM CET time front and center.
The post copy frames the event around proving resilience under pressure, from faster recovery across cloud and SaaS to AI-powered data security, and invites people to join in person or by livestream.

gallery.title: Empower Your Frontline: LinkedIn Carousel Ad
gallery.desc:
This LinkedIn carousel promoted Redzone's free eBook, The New Connected Workforce, with intro copy citing an average 29% increase in productivity, 74% increase in engagement, and 32% reduction in staff turnover.
Each card pairs a real plant-floor celebration with one bold headline, from 100% Paperless and Huddled & Connected to Results in Just 90 Days, before closing on a clean Download the eBook card.

gallery.title: Austin Fit Magazine Sweepstakes: Instagram Stories Ad
gallery.desc:
An Instagram Stories ad for Texas Sweats for Pets, a virtual fitness-a-thon from It's Time Texas. The hook: create a fundraiser for a chance to have you and your pet featured in an issue of Austin Fit Magazine.
A wide-eyed dog photo does most of the work, framed by hand-lettered orange headlines and a bright blue panel, with the Create a Fundraiser button and Learn More swipe-up kept within thumb's reach.

gallery.title: Book a Demo with QAD Redzone: Linkedin Video Ad
gallery.desc:
This LinkedIn video ad turned a Productivity & QA Roadshow at Pearson's Candy Company in St. Paul into a reason to book a demo. The post copy shares how the host and guest plants used Redzone to drive culture change and boost productivity upwards of 22%.
The footage moves from operators at work on the candy line to guest speakers telling their story on camera, so the proof comes from the people running the plants.

gallery.title: Responding to the Pandemic: Facebook Event Ad
gallery.desc:
A Facebook event ad for Responding to a Pandemic, a free live discussion in the Healthier Texas Summit Series, presented by Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas. The link headline spells out the angle: how Texas organizations are pivoting.
The creative leads with the date and time across the top, then lets a colorful illustration of masked faces carry the topic, with a Get Tickets button closing the loop.

gallery.title: Champion Employee Engagement: eBook Download Ad
gallery.desc:
Linemen set at the line of scrimmage make the backdrop for this Redzone eBook ad, with Champion Employee Engagement stacked in bold white type over the action. The copy offers five strategies to attract, engage, and retain frontline workers.
The football imagery gives a heavy manufacturing topic, the labor shortage, some momentum, and a single Download button is the only next step.

gallery.title: Living Healthier Hotline: Facebook Carousel Ad
gallery.desc:
I wrote this Facebook carousel for It's Time Texas' Living Healthier hotline, opening on a simple idea: transform your health for yourself, but not by yourself. It promoted free, bilingual, and confidential health coaching.
Each card pairs a real-life photo with one benefit, from meal planning advice to goal setting and progress tracking, with the hotline number on a bright banner and a Contact Us button on every card.

gallery.title: Mobile Ad for Pack Expo
gallery.desc:
The mobile companion to the Pack Expo leaderboard, sized to sit above articles on Food Business News. With less room to work with, I trimmed it to the essentials: the QAD Redzone lockup, See You at Booth SU-8233, and the Pack Expo Las Vegas badge.
The same frontline team photo carries over from the desktop banner, so the campaign reads as one consistent message across screens.

gallery.title: Healthier Texas Summit Recap: X (Twitter) Ad
gallery.desc:
After the Healthier Texas Summit Series wrapped, this X ad gave people a second chance to catch it, pointing to an archive with every session saved. The animated card cycles through session graphics, from Health and Social Justice to Partnering and Collaborating Across Sectors During a Crisis.
Each card keeps the summit's illustrated look, ending on the Healthier Texas Summit Series logo so the brand gets the last word.
